sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: After the 2019 and 2020 amendments, many procedural defaults are penalties rather than offences. The adjudicating officer gives notice and an opportunity of hearing. An appeal lies within the stated period. This route does not apply to an offence such as fraud under section 447, which remains criminal.
